name: Multimedia
title: Audiovisual Media Description
description: The Audiovisual Core is a set of vocabularies designed to represent metadata for biodiversity multimedia resources and collections. These vocabularies aim to represent information that will help to determine whether a particular resource or collection will be fit for some particular biodiversity science application before acquiring the media. Among others, the vocabularies address such concerns as the management of the media and collections, descriptions of their content, their taxonomic, geographic, and temporal coverage, and the appropriate ways to retrieve, attribute and reproduce them.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/terms/identifier
fields.title: Identifier
fields.description: An unambiguous reference to the resource within a given context.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/type
fields.title: Type
fields.description: The nature or genre of the resource.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/terms/type
fields.title: Type
fields.description: The nature or genre of the resource.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/subtypeLiteral
fields.title: Subtype (literal)
fields.description: A class, represented by a controlled value string, that provides for more specialization of the media item type than dc:type.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/subtype
fields.title: Subtype (IRI)
fields.description: A class, represented by an IRI, that provides for more specialization of the media item type than dcterms:type.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/terms/title
fields.title: Title
fields.description: A name given to the resource.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/terms/modified
fields.title: Modified
fields.description: Date on which the resource was changed.

fields.name: http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/MetadataDate
fields.title: Metadata Date
fields.description: The date and time that any metadata for this resource was last changed. It should be the same as or more recent than xmp:ModifyDate.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/metadataLanguageLiteral
fields.title: Metadata Language
fields.description: Language of description and other metadata (but not necessarily of the image itself) represented as an ISO639-2 three letter language code.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/metadataLanguage
fields.title: Metadata Language
fields.description: The URI of the language of description and other metadata (but not necessarily of the image itself) , from the ISO639-2 list of URIs for ISO 3-letter language codes, http://id.loc.gov/vocabulary/iso639-2.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/providerManagedID
fields.title: Provider-managed ID
fields.description: A free-form identifier (a simple number, an alphanumeric code, a URL, etc.) for the resource that is unique and meaningful primarily for the data provider.

fields.name: http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/Rating
fields.title: Rating
fields.description: A user-assigned rating for this file. The value shall be -1 or in the range [0..5], where -1 indicates "rejected" and 0 indicates "unrated".  If xmp:Rating is not present, a value of 0 should be assumed.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/commenterLiteral
fields.title: Commenter
fields.description: The name of a person who created a comment, or the literal "anonymous" (= anonymously commented).

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/commenter
fields.title: Commenter
fields.description: A URI denoting a person who created a comment.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/comments
fields.title: Comments
fields.description: Any comment provided on the media resource, as free-form text.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/reviewerLiteral
fields.title: Reviewer
fields.description: String providing the name of a reviewer.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/reviewer
fields.title: Reviewer
fields.description: URI for a reviewer.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/reviewerComments
fields.title: Reviewer Comments
fields.description: Any comment provided by a reviewer with expertise in the subject, as free-form text.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/terms/available
fields.title: Date Available
fields.description: Date (often a range) that the resource became or will become available.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/hasServiceAccessPoint
fields.title: Service Access Point
fields.description: In a chosen serialization (RDF, XML Schema, etc.) the potentially multiple service access points (e.g., for different resolutions of an image) might be provided in a referenced or in a nested object. This property identifies one such access point. That is, each of potentially multiple values of hasServiceAccessPoint identifies a set of representation-dependent metadata using the properties defined under the Service Access Point Vocabulary section of the Audiovisual Core Term List document.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/rights
fields.title: Copyright Statement
fields.description: Information about rights held in and over the resource.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/terms/rights
fields.title: Copyright Statement
fields.description: Information about rights held in and over the resource.

fields.name: http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/rights/Owner
fields.title: Copyright Owner
fields.description: A list of legal owners of the resource.

fields.name: http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/rights/UsageTerms
fields.title: License Terms
fields.description: A collection of text instructions on how a resource can be legally used, given in a variety of languages.

fields.name: http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/rights/WebStatement
fields.title: License URL
fields.description: A Web URL for a statement of the ownership and usage rights for this resource.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/licenseLogoURL
fields.title: License Logo URL
fields.description: A URL providing access to a logo that symbolizes the License.

fields.name: http://ns.adobe.com/photoshop/1.0/Credit
fields.title: Credit
fields.description: The credit to person(s) and/or organisation(s) required by the supplier of the item to be used when published. This is a free-text field.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/attributionLogoURL
fields.title: Attribution URL
fields.description: The URL of the icon or logo image to appear in source attribution.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/attributionLinkURL
fields.title: Attribution Link URL
fields.description: The URL where information about ownership, attribution, etc. of the resource may be found.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/fundingAttribution
fields.title: Funding
fields.description: Text description of organizations or individuals who funded the creation of the resource.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/source
fields.title: Published Source
fields.description: A related resource from which the described resource is derived.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/terms/source
fields.title: Published Source
fields.description: A related resource from which the described resource is derived.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/creator
fields.title: Creator
fields.description: An entity primarily responsible for making the resource.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/terms/creator
fields.title: Creator
fields.description: An entity primarily responsible for making the resource.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/providerLiteral
fields.title: Provider
fields.description: Name of the person or organization responsible for presenting the media resource.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/provider
fields.title: Provider
fields.description: URI for person or organization responsible for presenting the media resource.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/metadataCreatorLiteral
fields.title: Metadata Creator
fields.description: Name of the person or organization originally creating the resource metadata record.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/metadataCreator
fields.title: Metadata Creator
fields.description: A URI representing a person or organization originally creating the resource metadata record.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/metadataProviderLiteral
fields.title: Metadata Provider
fields.description: Name of the person or organization originally responsible for providing the resource metadata record.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/metadataProvider
fields.title: Metadata Provider
fields.description: URI of person or organization originally responsible for providing the resource metadata record.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/terms/description
fields.title: Description
fields.description: An account of the resource.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/caption
fields.title: Caption
fields.description: As alternative or in addition to description, a caption is free-form text to be displayed together with (rather than instead of) a resource that is suitable for captions (especially images).

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/language
fields.title: Language
fields.description: A language of the resource.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/terms/language
fields.title: Language
fields.description: A language of the resource.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/physicalSetting
fields.title: Physical Setting
fields.description: The setting of the content represented in media such as images, sounds, and movies if the provider deems them relevant.

fields.name: http://iptc.org/std/Iptc4xmpExt/2008-02-29/CVterm
fields.title: Subject Category (IRI)
fields.description: A term to describe the content of the image by a value from a Controlled Vocabulary.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/subjectCategoryVocabulary
fields.title: Subject Category Vocabulary
fields.description: Any controlled vocabulary from which values for ac:CVtermLiteral have been drawn.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/tag
fields.title: Tag
fields.description: General keywords or tags.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/freqHigh
fields.title: Upper frequency bound
fields.description: The highest frequency of the phenomena reflected in the multimedia item or Region of Interest.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/freqLow
fields.title: Lower frequency bound
fields.description: The lowest frequency of the phenomena reflected in the multimedia item or Region of Interest.

fields.name: http://iptc.org/std/Iptc4xmpExt/2008-02-29/LocationShown
fields.title: Location Shown
fields.description: A location the content of the item is about. For photos that is a location shown in the image.

fields.name: http://iptc.org/std/Iptc4xmpExt/2008-02-29/WorldRegion
fields.title: World Region
fields.description: The name of a world region of a location. This element is at the first (topI) level of a topdown geographical hierarchy.

fields.name: http://iptc.org/std/Iptc4xmpExt/2008-02-29/CountryCode
fields.title: Country Code
fields.description: The ISO code of a country of a location. This element is at the second level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.

fields.name: http://iptc.org/std/Iptc4xmpExt/2008-02-29/CountryName
fields.title: Country Name
fields.description: The name of a country of a location. This element is at the second level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.

fields.name: http://iptc.org/std/Iptc4xmpExt/2008-02-29/ProvinceState
fields.title: Province or State
fields.description: The name of a subregion of a country - a province or state - of a location. This element is at the third level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.

fields.name: http://iptc.org/std/Iptc4xmpExt/2008-02-29/City
fields.title: City or Place Name
fields.description: Name of the city of a location. This element is at the fourth level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.

fields.name: http://iptc.org/std/Iptc4xmpExt/2008-02-29/Sublocation
fields.title: Sublocation
fields.description: Name of a sublocation. This sublocation name could either be the name of a sublocation to a city or the name of a well known location or (natural) monument outside a city. In the sense of a sublocation to a city this element is at the fifth level of a top-down geographical hierarchy.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/continent
fields.title: Continent
fields.description: The name of the continent in which the Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/coordinatePrecision
fields.title: Coordinate Precision
fields.description: A decimal representation of the precision of the coordinates given in the decimalLatitude and decimalLongitude.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/coordinateUncertaintyInMeters
fields.title: Coordinate Uncertainty In Meters
fields.description: The horizontal distance (in meters) from the given decimalLatitude and decimalLongitude describing the smallest circle containing the whole of the Location. Leave the value empty if the uncertainty is unknown, cannot be estimated, or is not applicable (because there are no coordinates). Zero is not a valid value for this term.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/country
fields.title: Country
fields.description: The name of the country or major administrative unit in which the Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/countryCode
fields.title: Country Code
fields.description: The standard code for the country in which the Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/county
fields.title: County
fields.description: The full, unabbreviated name of the next smaller administrative region than stateProvince (county, shire, department, etc.) in which the Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/decimalLatitude
fields.title: Decimal Latitude
fields.description: The geographic latitude (in decimal degrees, using the spatial reference system given in geodeticDatum) of the geographic center of a Location. Positive values are north of the Equator, negative values are south of it. Legal values lie between -90 and 90, inclusive.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/decimalLongitude
fields.title: Decimal Longitude
fields.description: The geographic longitude (in decimal degrees, using the spatial reference system given in geodeticDatum) of the geographic center of a Location. Positive values are east of the Greenwich Meridian, negative values are west of it. Legal values lie between -180 and 180, inclusive.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/footprintSpatialFit
fields.title: Footprint Spatial Fit
fields.description: The ratio of the area of the footprint (footprintWKT) to the area of the true (original, or most specific) spatial representation of the Location. Legal values are 0, greater than or equal to 1, or undefined. A value of 1 is an exact match or 100% overlap. A value of 0 should be used if the given footprint does not completely contain the original representation. The footprintSpatialFit is undefined (and should be left empty) if the original representation is a point without uncertainty and the given georeference is not that same point (without uncertainty). If both the original and the given georeference are the same point, the footprintSpatialFit is 1.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/footprintSRS
fields.title: Footprint SRS
fields.description: A Well-Known Text (WKT) representation of the Spatial Reference System (SRS) for the footprintWKT of the Location. Do not use this term to describe the SRS of the decimalLatitude and decimalLongitude, even if it is the same as for the footprintWKT - use the geodeticDatum instead.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/footprintWKT
fields.title: Footprint WKT
fields.description: A Well-Known Text (WKT) representation of the shape (footprint, geometry) that defines the Location. A Location may have both a point-radius representation (see decimalLatitude) and a footprint representation, and they may differ from each other.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/geodeticDatum
fields.title: Geodetic Datum
fields.description: The ellipsoid, geodetic datum, or spatial reference system (SRS) upon which the geographic coordinates given in decimalLatitude and decimalLongitude as based.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferencedBy
fields.title: Georeferenced By
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of names of people, groups, or organizations who determined the georeference (spatial representation) for the Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferenceProtocol
fields.title: Georeference Protocol
fields.description: A description or reference to the methods used to determine the spatial footprint, coordinates, and uncertainties.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferenceRemarks
fields.title: Georeference Remarks
fields.description: Notes or comments about the spatial description determination, explaining assumptions made in addition or opposition to the those formalized in the method referred to in georeferenceProtocol.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferenceSources
fields.title: Georeference Sources
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of maps, gazetteers, or other resources used to georeference the Location, described specifically enough to allow anyone in the future to use the same resources.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/georeferenceVerificationStatus
fields.title: Georeference Verification Status
fields.description: A categorical description of the extent to which the georeference has been verified to represent the best possible spatial description.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/higherGeography
fields.title: Higher Geography
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of geographic names less specific than the information captured in the locality term.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/higherGeographyID
fields.title: Higher Geography ID
fields.description: An identifier for the geographic region within which the Location occurred.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/island
fields.title: Island
fields.description: The name of the island on or near which the Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/islandGroup
fields.title: Island Group
fields.description: The name of the island group in which the Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locality
fields.title: Locality
fields.description: The specific description of the place. Less specific geographic information can be provided in other geographic terms (higherGeography, continent, country, stateProvince, county, municipality, waterBody, island, islandGroup). This term may contain information modified from the original to correct perceived errors or standardize the description.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locationAccordingTo
fields.title: Location According To
fields.description: Information about the source of this Location information. Could be a publication (gazetteer), institution, or team of individuals.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locationID
fields.title: Location ID
fields.description: An identifier for the set of location information (data associated with dcterms:Location). May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locationRemarks
fields.title: Location Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/maximumDepthInMeters
fields.title: Maximum Depth In Meters
fields.description: The greater depth of a range of depth below the local surface, in meters.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/maximumDistanceAboveSurfaceInMeters
fields.title: Maximum Distance Above Surface In Meters
fields.description: The greater distance in a range of distance from a reference surface in the vertical direction, in meters. Use positive values for locations above the surface, negative values for locations below. If depth measures are given, the reference surface is the location given by the depth, otherwise the reference surface is the location given by the elevation.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/maximumElevationInMeters
fields.title: Maximum Elevation In Meters
fields.description: The upper limit of the range of elevation (altitude, usually above sea level), in meters.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/minimumDepthInMeters
fields.title: Minimum Depth In Meters
fields.description: The lesser depth of a range of depth below the local surface, in meters.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/minimumDistanceAboveSurfaceInMeters
fields.title: Minimum Distance Above Surface In Meters
fields.description: The lesser distance in a range of distance from a reference surface in the vertical direction, in meters. Use positive values for locations above the surface, negative values for locations below. If depth measures are given, the reference surface is the location given by the depth, otherwise the reference surface is the location given by the elevation.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/minimumElevationInMeters
fields.title: Minimum Elevation In Meters
fields.description: The lower limit of the range of elevation (altitude, usually above sea level), in meters.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/municipality
fields.title: Municipality
fields.description: The full, unabbreviated name of the next smaller administrative region than county (city, municipality, etc.) in which the Location occurs. Do not use this term for a nearby named place that does not contain the actual location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/pointRadiusSpatialFit
fields.title: Point Radius Spatial Fit
fields.description: The ratio of the area of the point-radius (decimalLatitude, decimalLongitude, coordinateUncertaintyInMeters) to the area of the true (original, or most specific) spatial representation of the Location. Legal values are 0, greater than or equal to 1, or undefined. A value of 1 is an exact match or 100% overlap. A value of 0 should be used if the given point-radius does not completely contain the original representation. The pointRadiusSpatialFit is undefined (and should be left empty) if the original representation is a point without uncertainty and the given georeference is not that same point (without uncertainty). If both the original and the given georeference are the same point, the pointRadiusSpatialFit is 1.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/stateProvince
fields.title: State Province
fields.description: The name of the next smaller administrative region than country (state, province, canton, department, region, etc.) in which the Location occurs.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimCoordinates
fields.title: Verbatim Coordinates
fields.description: The verbatim original spatial coordinates of the Location. The coordinate ellipsoid, geodeticDatum, or full Spatial Reference System (SRS) for these coordinates should be stored in verbatimSRS and the coordinate system should be stored in verbatimCoordinateSystem.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimCoordinateSystem
fields.title: Verbatim Coordinate System
fields.description: The coordinate format for the verbatimLatitude and verbatimLongitude or the verbatimCoordinates of the Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimElevation
fields.title: Verbatim Elevation
fields.description: The original description of the elevation (altitude, usually above sea level) of the Location.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimLatitude
fields.title: Verbatim Latitude
fields.description: The verbatim original latitude of the Location. The coordinate ellipsoid, geodeticDatum, or full Spatial Reference System (SRS) for these coordinates should be stored in verbatimSRS and the coordinate system should be stored in verbatimCoordinateSystem.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimLocality
fields.title: Verbatim Locality
fields.description: The original textual description of the place.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimLongitude
fields.title: Verbatim Longitude
fields.description: The verbatim original longitude of the Location. The coordinate ellipsoid, geodeticDatum, or full Spatial Reference System (SRS) for these coordinates should be stored in verbatimSRS and the coordinate system should be stored in verbatimCoordinateSystem.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimSRS
fields.title: Verbatim SRS
fields.description: The ellipsoid, geodetic datum, or spatial reference system (SRS) upon which coordinates given in verbatimLatitude and verbatimLongitude, or verbatimCoordinates are based.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/waterBody
fields.title: Water Body
fields.description: The name of the water body in which the Location occurs. Recommended best practice is to use a controlled vocabulary such as the Getty Thesaurus of Geographic Names.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/terms/temporal
fields.title: Temporal Coverage
fields.description: Temporal characteristics of the resource.

fields.name: http://ns.adobe.com/xap/1.0/CreateDate
fields.title: Original Date and Time
fields.description: The date and time the resource was created. For a digital file, this need not match a file-system creation time.  For a freshly created resource, it should be close to that time, modulo the time taken to write the file.  Later file transfer, copying, and so on, can make the file-system time arbitrarily different.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/timeOfDay
fields.title: Time of Day
fields.description: Free text information beyond exact clock times.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/taxonCoverage
fields.title: Taxon Coverage
fields.description: A higher taxon (e.g., a genus, family, or order) at the level of the genus or higher, that covers all taxa that are the primary subject of the resource (which may be a media item or a collection).

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/scientificName
fields.title: Scientific Taxon Name
fields.description: The full scientific name, with authorship and date information if known. When forming part of an Identification, this should be the name in lowest level taxonomic rank that can be determined. This term should not contain identification qualifications, which should instead be supplied in the IdentificationQualifier term.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/identificationQualifier
fields.title: Identification Qualifier
fields.description: A brief phrase or a standard term ("cf.", "aff.") to express the determiner's doubts about the Identification.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/vernacularName
fields.title: Common Name
fields.description: A common or vernacular name.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/nameAccordingTo
fields.title: Name According To
fields.description: The reference to the source in which the specific taxon concept circumscription is defined or implied - traditionally signified by the Latin "sensu" or "sec." (from secundum, meaning "according to"). For taxa that result from identifications, a reference to the keys, monographs, experts and other sources should be given.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/scientificNameID
fields.title: Scientific Name ID
fields.description: An identifier for the nomenclatural (not taxonomic) details of a scientific name.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/otherScientificName
fields.title: Other Scientific Name
fields.description: One or several Scientific Taxon Names that are synonyms to the Scientific Taxon Name may be provided here.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/identifiedBy
fields.title: Identified By
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of names of people, groups, or organizations who assigned the Taxon to the subject.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/dateIdentified
fields.title: Date Identified
fields.description: The date on which the subject was determined as representing the Taxon.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/taxonCount
fields.title: Taxon Count
fields.description: An exact or estimated number of taxa at the lowest applicable taxon rank (usually species or infraspecific) represented by the media resource (item or collection).

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/subjectPart
fields.title: Subject Part
fields.description: The portion or product of organism morphology, behaviour, environment, etc. that is either predominantly shown or particularly well exemplified by the media resource, denoted by an IRI.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/subjectPartLiteral
fields.title: Subject Part (literal)
fields.description: The portion or product of organism morphology, behaviour, environment, etc. that is either predominantly shown or particularly well exemplified by the media resource, denoted by a controlled value string.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/sex
fields.title: Subject Sex
fields.description: The sex of the biological individual(s) represented in the Occurrence.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/lifeStage
fields.title: Subject Life Stage
fields.description: The age class or life stage of the biological individual(s) at the time the Occurrence was recorded.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/subjectOrientation
fields.title: Subject Orientation
fields.description: Specific orientation (= direction, view angle) of the subject represented in the media resource with respect to the acquisition device, denoted by an IRI.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/subjectOrientationLiteral
fields.title: Subject Orientation (literal)
fields.description: Specific orientation (= direction, view angle) of the subject represented in the media resource with respect to the acquisition device, denoted by a controlled value string.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/preparations
fields.title: Subject Preparation Technique
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of preparations and preservation methods for a specimen.

fields.name: http://iptc.org/std/Iptc4xmpExt/2008-02-29/LocationCreated
fields.title: Location Created
fields.description: The location the content of the item was created

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/digitizationDate
fields.title: Date and Time Digitized
fields.description: Date the first digital version was created, if different from Original Date and Time found in the Temporal Coverage Vocabulary.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/captureDevice
fields.title: Capture Device
fields.description: Free form text describing the device or devices used to create the resource.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/resourceCreationTechnique
fields.title: Resource Creation Technique
fields.description: Information about technical aspects of the creation and digitization process of the resource. This includes modification steps ("retouching") after the initial resource capture.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/frameRate
fields.title: Frame Rate
fields.description: The decimal fraction representing the frequency (rate) at which consecutive images (frames) were captured in real time for a moving image, expressed as the number of frames per second.

fields.name: http://purl.org/ontology/mo/sample_rate
fields.title: Sample Rate
fields.description: Associates a digital signal to its sample rate.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/IDofContainingCollection
fields.title: ID of Containing Collection
fields.description: If the resource is contained in a Collection, this field identifies that Collection uniquely.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/relatedResourceID
fields.title: Related Resource ID
fields.description: Resource related in ways not specified through a collection, e.g., before-after images; time-lapse series; different orientations/angles of view

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/providerID
fields.title: Provider ID
fields.description: A globally unique ID of the provider of the current AC metadata record.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/derivedFrom
fields.title: Derived From
fields.description: A reference to an original resource from which the current one is derived.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/associatedSpecimenReference
fields.title: Associated Specimen Reference
fields.description: A reference to a specimen associated with this resource.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/associatedObservationReference
fields.title: Associated Observation Reference
fields.description: A reference to an observation associated with this resource.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/accessURI
fields.title: Access URI
fields.description: A URI that uniquely identifies a service that provides a representation of the underlying resource.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/format
fields.title: Format (literal)
fields.description: The file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource.

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/terms/format
fields.title: Format (IRI)
fields.description: The file format, physical medium, or dimensions of the resource.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/variantLiteral
fields.title: Variant (literal)
fields.description: The category describing this Service Access Point variant, denoted by a controlled value string.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/variant
fields.title: Variant (IRI)
fields.description: The category describing this Service Access Point variant, denoted by an IRI.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/variantDescription
fields.title: Variant Description
fields.description: Text that describes this Service Access Point variant

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/furtherInformationURL
fields.title: Further Information URL
fields.description: The URL of a Web site that provides additional information about the version of the media resource that is provided by the Service Access Point.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/licensingException
fields.title: Licensing Exception Statement
fields.description: The licensing statement for this variant of the media resource if different from that given in the License Statement property of the resource.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/serviceExpectation
fields.title: Service Expectation
fields.description: A term that describes what service expectations users may have of the ac:accessURI.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/hashFunction
fields.title: Hash Function
fields.description: The cryptographic hash function used to compute the value given in the Hash Value.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/hashValue
fields.title: Hash
fields.description: The value computed by a hash function applied to the media that will be delivered at the access point.

fields.name: http://ns.adobe.com/exif/1.0/PixelXDimension
fields.title: Image Width
fields.description: Information specific to compressed data. When a compressed file is recorded, the valid width of the meaningful image shall be recorded in this tag, whether or not there is padding data or a restart marker.  This tag shall not exist in an uncompressed file.

fields.name: http://ns.adobe.com/exif/1.0/PixelYDimension
fields.title: Image Height
fields.description: Information specific to compressed data. When a compressed file is recorded, the valid height of the meaningful image shall be recorded in this tag, whether or not there is padding data or a restart marker.  This tag shall not exist in an uncompressed file.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/hasROI
fields.title: Has Region of Interest
fields.description: A region of interest located within the subject media item.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/isROIOf
fields.title: Is Region of Interest of
fields.description: The media item within which a region of interest is located.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/xFrac
fields.title: Fractional X
fields.description: The horizontal position of a reference point, measured from the left side of the media item and expressed as a decimal fraction of the width of the media item.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/yFrac
fields.title: Fractional Y
fields.description: The vertical position of a reference point, measured from the top of the media item and expressed as a decimal fraction of the height of the media item.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/widthFrac
fields.title: Fractional Width
fields.description: The width of the bounding rectangle, expressed as a decimal fraction of the width of the media item.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/heightFrac
fields.title: Fractional Height
fields.description: The height of the bounding rectangle, expressed as a decimal fraction of the height of the media item.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/radius
fields.title: Radius
fields.description: The radius of a bounding circle or arc, expressed as a fraction of the width of the media item.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/startTime
fields.title: Start Time in Seconds
fields.description: The beginning of a temporal region, specified as an absolute offset relative to the beginning of the media item (this corresponds to Normal Play Time RFC 2326), specified as seconds, with an optional fractional part to indicate milliseconds or finer.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/endTime
fields.title: End Time in Seconds
fields.description: The end of a temporal region, specified as an absolute offset relative to the beginning of the media item (this corresponds to Normal Play Time RFC 2326), specified as seconds, with an optional fractional part to indicate milliseconds or finer.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/startTimestamp
fields.title: Start Timestamp
fields.description: The beginning of a temporal region, specified as real-world clock time ISO 8601 timestamps, using UTC timezone, with an optional fractional part to indicate milliseconds or finer. There is no limit on the number of decimal places for the decimal fraction.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/endTimestamp
fields.title: End Timestamp
fields.description: The end of a temporal region, specified as real-world clock time ISO 8601 timestamps, using UTC timezone, with an optional fractional part to indicate milliseconds or finer. There is no limit on the number of decimal places for the decimal fraction.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/mediaDuration
fields.title: Media Duration
fields.description: The playback duration of an audio or video file in seconds.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/ac/terms/mediaSpeed
fields.title: Media Speed
fields.description: The decimal fraction representing the natural speed over the encoded speed.

name: TypesAndSpecimen
title: Types and Specimen
description: An extension for specimens and types, including type specimens, type species and type genera and simple specimens unrelated to types.
subject: dwc:Taxon

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/typeStatus
fields.title: typeStatus
fields.description: The type status of the specimen, not used for type species or type genus

fields.name: http://rs.gbif.org/terms/1.0/typeDesignationType
fields.title: typeDesignationType
fields.description: The reason why this specimen or name is designated as a type.

fields.name: http://rs.gbif.org/terms/1.0/typeDesignatedBy
fields.title: typeDesignatedBy
fields.description: The citation of the publication where the type designation is found

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/scientificName
fields.title: scientificName
fields.description: In case of type specimens the scientific name originally used on the label. Not necessarily the same as the currently recognized name. In case of type species or genera it should be the species or genus name that typifies the higher taxon.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/taxonRank
fields.title: taxonRank
fields.description: The rank of the taxon bearing the scientific name

fields.name: http://purl.org/dc/terms/bibliographicCitation
fields.title: bibliographicCitation
fields.description: A text string citating the described specimen. Often found in taxonomic treatments and frequently based on institution code and catalog number.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/occurrenceID
fields.title: occurrenceID
fields.description: An identifier for the specimen, preferably a resolvable globally unique identifier.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/institutionCode
fields.title: institutionCode
fields.description: The name (or acronym) in use by the institution having custody of the object(s) or information referred to in the record.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/institutionID
fields.title: institutionID
fields.description: An identifier for the institution having custody of the object(s) or information referred to in the record.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/collectionCode
fields.title: collectionCode
fields.description: The name, acronym, coden, or initialism identifying the collection or data set from which the record was derived.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/collectionID
fields.title: collectionID
fields.description: An identifier for the collection or dataset from which the record was derived.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/catalogNumber
fields.title: catalogNumber
fields.description: An identifier (preferably unique) for the record within the data set or collection.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/locality
fields.title: locality
fields.description: The location where the the specimen was collected. In case of type specimens the type locality.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/sex
fields.title: sex
fields.description: The sex of the specimen being referenced.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/recordedBy
fields.title: recordedBy
fields.description: The primary collector or observer, especially one who applies a personal identifier (recordNumber), should be listed first.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimEventDate
fields.title: verbatimEventDate
fields.description: The date when the specimen was collected

fields.name: http://rs.gbif.org/terms/1.0/verbatimLabel
fields.title: verbatimLabel
fields.description: The full, verbatim text from the specimen label

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimLongitude
fields.title: verbatimLongitude
fields.description: The geographic longitude

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimLatitude
fields.title: verbatimLatitude
fields.description: The geographic latitude

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/datasetID
fields.title: datasetID
fields.description: An identifier for a subset of data.

name: Identification
title: Darwin Core Identification History
description: Extended support for multiple identifications (determinations) of species Darwin Core Occurrences. All identifications including the most current one should be listed, while the current one should also be repeated in the Darwin Core Occurrence Core.
subject: dwc:Occurrence

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/identificationID
fields.title: Identification ID
fields.description: An identifier for the dwc:Identification (the body of information associated with the assignment of a scientific name). May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimIdentification
fields.title: Verbatim Identification
fields.description: A string representing the taxonomic identification as it appeared in the original record.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/identificationQualifier
fields.title: Identification Qualifier
fields.description: A brief phrase or a standard term ("cf.", "aff.") to express the determiner's doubts about the dwc:Identification.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/typeStatus
fields.title: Type Status
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of nomenclatural types (type status, typified scientific name, publication) applied to the subject.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/identifiedBy
fields.title: Identified By
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of names of people, groups, or organizations who assigned the dwc:Taxon to the subject.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/identifiedByID
fields.title: Identified By ID
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of the globally unique identifier for the person, people, groups, or organizations responsible for assigning the dwc:Taxon to the subject.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/dateIdentified
fields.title: Date Identified
fields.description: The date on which the subject was determined as representing the dwc:Taxon.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/identificationReferences
fields.title: Identification References
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of references (publication, global unique identifier, URI) used in the dwc:Identification.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/identificationVerificationStatus
fields.title: Identification Verification Status
fields.description: A categorical indicator of the extent to which the taxonomic identification has been verified to be correct.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/identificationRemarks
fields.title: Identification Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the dwc:Identification.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/taxonID
fields.title: Taxon ID
fields.description: An identifier for the set of dwc:Taxon information. May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/scientificNameID
fields.title: Scientific Name ID
fields.description: An identifier for the nomenclatural (not taxonomic) details of a scientific name.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/acceptedNameUsageID
fields.title: Accepted Name Usage ID
fields.description: An identifier for the name usage (documented meaning of the name according to a source) of the currently valid (zoological) or accepted (botanical) taxon.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/parentNameUsageID
fields.title: Parent Name Usage ID
fields.description: An identifier for the name usage (documented meaning of the name according to a source) of the direct, most proximate higher-rank parent taxon (in a classification) of the most specific element of the dwc:scientificName.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/originalNameUsageID
fields.title: Original Name Usage ID
fields.description: An identifier for the name usage (documented meaning of the name according to a source) in which the terminal element of the dwc:scientificName was originally established under the rules of the associated dwc:nomenclaturalCode.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/nameAccordingToID
fields.title: Name According To ID
fields.description: An identifier for the source in which the specific taxon concept circumscription is defined or implied. See dwc:nameAccordingTo.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/namePublishedInID
fields.title: Name Published In ID
fields.description: An identifier for the publication in which the dwc:scientificName was originally established under the rules of the associated dwc:nomenclaturalCode.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/taxonConceptID
fields.title: Taxon Concept ID
fields.description: An identifier for the taxonomic concept to which the record refers - not for the nomenclatural details of a dwc:Taxon.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/scientificName
fields.title: Scientific Name
fields.description: The full scientific name, with authorship and date information if known. When forming part of a dwc:Identification, this should be the name in lowest level taxonomic rank that can be determined. This term should not contain identification qualifications, which should instead be supplied in the dwc:identificationQualifier term.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/acceptedNameUsage
fields.title: Accepted Name Usage
fields.description: The full name, with authorship and date information if known, of the currently valid (zoological) or accepted (botanical) dwc:Taxon.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/parentNameUsage
fields.title: Parent Name Usage
fields.description: The full name, with authorship and date information if known, of the direct, most proximate higher-rank parent dwc:Taxon (in a classification) of the most specific element of the dwc:scientificName.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/originalNameUsage
fields.title: Original Name Usage
fields.description: The taxon name, with authorship and date information if known, as it originally appeared when first established under the rules of the associated dwc:nomenclaturalCode. The basionym (botany) or basonym (bacteriology) of the dwc:scientificName or the senior/earlier homonym for replaced names.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/nameAccordingTo
fields.title: Name According To
fields.description: The reference to the source in which the specific taxon concept circumscription is defined or implied - traditionally signified by the Latin "sensu" or "sec." (from secundum, meaning "according to"). For taxa that result from identifications, a reference to the keys, monographs, experts and other sources should be given.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/namePublishedIn
fields.title: Name Published In
fields.description: A reference for the publication in which the dwc:scientificName was originally established under the rules of the associated dwc:nomenclaturalCode.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/namePublishedInYear
fields.title: Name Published In Year
fields.description: The four-digit year in which the dwc:scientificName was published.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/higherClassification
fields.title: Higher Classification
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of taxa names terminating at the rank immediately superior to the referenced dwc:Taxon.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/kingdom
fields.title: Kingdom
fields.description: The full scientific name of the kingdom in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/phylum
fields.title: Phylum
fields.description: The full scientific name of the phylum or division in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/class
fields.title: Class
fields.description: The full scientific name of the class in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/order
fields.title: Order
fields.description: The full scientific name of the order in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/superfamily
fields.title: Superfamily
fields.description: The full scientific name of the superfamily in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/family
fields.title: Family
fields.description: The full scientific name of the family in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/subfamily
fields.title: Subfamily
fields.description: The full scientific name of the subfamily in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/tribe
fields.title: Tribe
fields.description: The full scientific name of the tribe in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/subtribe
fields.title: Subtribe
fields.description: The full scientific name of the subtribe in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/genus
fields.title: Genus
fields.description: The full scientific name of the genus in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/genericName
fields.title: Generic Name
fields.description: The genus part of the dwc:scientificName without authorship.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/subgenus
fields.title: Subgenus
fields.description: The full scientific name of the subgenus in which the dwc:Taxon is classified.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/infragenericEpithet
fields.title: Infrageneric Epithet
fields.description: The infrageneric part of a binomial name at ranks above species but below genus.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/specificEpithet
fields.title: Specific Epithet
fields.description: The name of the first or species epithet of the dwc:scientificName.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/infraspecificEpithet
fields.title: Infraspecific Epithet
fields.description: The name of the lowest or terminal infraspecific epithet of the dwc:scientificName, excluding any rank designation.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/cultivarEpithet
fields.title: Cultivar Epithet
fields.description: Part of the name of a cultivar, cultivar group or grex that follows the dwc:scientificName.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/taxonRank
fields.title: Taxon Rank
fields.description: The taxonomic rank of the most specific name in the dwc:scientificName.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimTaxonRank
fields.title: Verbatim Taxon Rank
fields.description: The taxonomic rank of the most specific name in the dwc:scientificName as it appears in the original record.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/scientificNameAuthorship
fields.title: Scientific Name Authorship
fields.description: The authorship information for the dwc:scientificName formatted according to the conventions of the applicable dwc:nomenclaturalCode.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/vernacularName
fields.title: Vernacular Name
fields.description: A common or vernacular name.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/nomenclaturalCode
fields.title: Nomenclatural Code
fields.description: The nomenclatural code (or codes in the case of an ambiregnal name) under which the dwc:scientificName is constructed.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/taxonomicStatus
fields.title: Taxonomic Status
fields.description: The status of the use of the dwc:scientificName as a label for a taxon. Requires taxonomic opinion to define the scope of a dwc:Taxon. Rules of priority then are used to define the taxonomic status of the nomenclature contained in that scope, combined with the experts opinion. It must be linked to a specific taxonomic reference that defines the concept.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/nomenclaturalStatus
fields.title: Nomenclatural Status
fields.description: The status related to the original publication of the name and its conformance to the relevant rules of nomenclature. It is based essentially on an algorithm according to the business rules of the code. It requires no taxonomic opinion.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/taxonRemarks
fields.title: Taxon Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the taxon or name.

name: MeasurementOrFacts
title: Darwin Core Measurement or Facts
description: Extended support for multiple measurements or facts associated with a Darwin Core Occurrence, Event, or Taxon Core.
subject: dwc:Occurrence dwc:Event dwc:Taxon

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/measurementID
fields.title: Measurement ID
fields.description: An identifier for the dwc:MeasurementOrFact (information pertaining to measurements, facts, characteristics, or assertions). May be a global unique identifier or an identifier specific to the data set.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/parentMeasurementID
fields.title: Parent Measurement ID
fields.description: An identifier for a broader dwc:MeasurementOrFact that groups this and potentially other dwc:MeasurementOrFacts.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/measurementType
fields.title: Measurement Type
fields.description: The nature of the measurement, fact, characteristic, or assertion.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/verbatimMeasurementType
fields.title: Verbatim Measurement Type
fields.description: A string representing the type of measurement or fact as it appeared in the original record.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/measurementValue
fields.title: Measurement Value
fields.description: The value of the measurement, fact, characteristic, or assertion.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/measurementAccuracy
fields.title: Measurement Accuracy
fields.description: The description of the potential error associated with the dwc:measurementValue.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/measurementUnit
fields.title: Measurement Unit
fields.description: The units associated with the dwc:measurementValue.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/measurementDeterminedBy
fields.title: Measurement Determined By
fields.description: A list (concatenated and separated) of names of people, groups, or organizations who determined the value of the dwc:MeasurementOrFact.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/measurementDeterminedDate
fields.title: Measurement Determined Date
fields.description: The date on which the dwc:MeasurementOrFact was made.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/measurementMethod
fields.title: Measurement Method
fields.description: A description of or reference to (publication, URI) the method or protocol used to determine the measurement, fact, characteristic, or assertion.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/measurementRemarks
fields.title: Measurement Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes accompanying the dwc:MeasurementOrFact.

name: ResourceRelationship
title: Darwin Core Resource Relationship
description: Extended support for relationships between resources in a Darwin Core Occurrence, Event, or Taxon Core to resources in an extension or external to the data set. The identifiers for subject (resourceID) and object (relatedResourceID) may exist in the dataset or be accessible via an externally resolvable identifiers.
subject: dwc:Occurrence dwc:Event dwc:Taxon

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/resourceRelationshipID
fields.title: Resource Relationship ID
fields.description: An identifier for an instance of relationship between one resource (the subject) and another (dwc:relatedResource, the object).

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/resourceID
fields.title: Resource ID
fields.description: An identifier for the resource that is the subject of the relationship.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/relationshipOfResourceID
fields.title: Relationship Of Resource ID
fields.description: An identifier for the relationship type (predicate) that connects the subject identified by dwc:resourceID to its object identified by dwc:relatedResourceID.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/relatedResourceID
fields.title: Related Resource ID
fields.description: An identifier for a related resource (the object, rather than the subject of the relationship).

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/relationshipOfResource
fields.title: Relationship Of Resource
fields.description: The relationship of the subject (identified by dwc:resourceID) to the object (identified by dwc:relatedResourceID).

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/relationshipAccordingTo
fields.title: Relationship According To
fields.description: The source (person, organization, publication, reference) establishing the relationship between the two resources.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/relationshipEstablishedDate
fields.title: Relationship Established Date
fields.description: The date-time on which the relationship between the two resources was established.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/relationshipRemarks
fields.title: Relationship Remarks
fields.description: Comments or notes about the relationship between the two resources.

name: HumboldtEcologicalInventory
title: Humboldt Ecological Inventory
description: Extended support for Darwin Core Events related to ecological inventories.
subject: dwc:Event

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/eco/terms/siteCount
fields.title: Site Count
fields.description: Total number of individual sites surveyed during the dwc:Event.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/eco/terms/siteNestingDescription
fields.title: Site Nesting Description

name: dnaDerivedData
title: DNA derived data
description: An extension to Occurrence and Event cores to capture information relating to DNA. This extension is based on the MIxS extension for Darwin Core (underway), with additions from GGBN and MIQE standards and recommendations. This definition supports the outcomes documented in Publishing DNA-derived data through biodiversity data platforms (https://doi.org/10.35035/doc-vf1a-nr22).  This extension is subject to change, and recommended for early adopters who understand that data remapping may be required as things evolve.

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0001107
fields.title: samp_name
fields.description: Sample Name is a name that you choose for the sample. It can have any format, but we suggest that you make it concise, unique and consistent within your lab, and as informative as possible. Every Sample Name from a single Submitter must be unique.

fields.name: http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/occurrenceID
fields.title: occurrenceID
fields.description: The identifier of the occurrence the DNA sequence relates to. If not applicable, it should be left empty.

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000092
fields.title: project_name
fields.description: Name of the project within which the sequencing was organized

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000008
fields.title: experimental_factor
fields.description: Experimental factors are essentially the variable aspects of an experiment design which can be used to describe an experiment, or set of experiments, in an increasingly detailed manner. This field accepts ontology terms from Experimental Factor Ontology (EFO) and/or Ontology for Biomedical Investigations (OBI). For a browser of EFO (v 2.95) terms, please see http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/EFO; for a browser of OBI (v 2018-02-12) terms please see http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/OBI

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0001320
fields.title: samp_taxon_id
fields.description: NCBI taxon id of the sample. Maybe be a single taxon or mixed taxa sample. Use "synthetic metagenome" for mock community/positive controls, or "blank sample" for negative controls

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0001321
fields.title: neg_cont_type
fields.description: The substance or equipment used as a negative control in an investigation

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0001322
fields.title: pos_cont_type
fields.description: The substance, mixture, product, or apparatus used to verify that a process which is part of an investigation delivers a true positive

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000012
fields.title: env_broad_scale
fields.description: In this field, report which major environmental system your sample or specimen came from. The systems identified should have a coarse spatial grain, to provide the general environmental context of where the sampling was done (e.g. were you in the desert or a rainforest?). We recommend using subclasses of ENVO’s biome class: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_00000428. Format (one term): termLabel [termID], Format (multiple terms): termLabel [termID]|termLabel [termID]|termLabel [termID]. Example: Annotating a water sample from the photic zone in middle of the Atlantic Ocean, consider: oceanic epipelagic zone biome [ENVO:01000033]. Example: Annotating a sample from the Amazon rainforest consider: tropical moist broadleaf forest biome [ENVO:01000228]. If needed, request new terms on the ENVO tracker, identified here: http://www.obofoundry.org/ontology/envo.html

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000013
fields.title: env_local_scale
fields.description: In this field, report the entity or entities which are in your sample or specimen’s local vicinity and which you believe have significant causal influences on your sample or specimen. Please use terms that are present in ENVO and which are of smaller spatial grain than your entry for env_broad_scale. Format (one term): termLabel [termID]; Format (multiple terms): termLabel [termID]|termLabel [termID]|termLabel [termID]. Example: Annotating a pooled sample taken from various vegetation layers in a forest consider: canopy [ENVO:00000047]|herb and fern layer [ENVO:01000337]|litter layer [ENVO:01000338]|understory [01000335]|shrub layer [ENVO:01000336]. If needed, request new terms on the ENVO tracker, identified here: http://www.obofoundry.org/ontology/envo.html

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000014
fields.title: env_medium
fields.description: In this field, report which environmental material or materials (pipe separated) immediately surrounded your sample or specimen prior to sampling, using one or more subclasses of ENVO’s environmental material class: http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO_00010483. Format (one term): termLabel [termID]; Format (multiple terms): termLabel [termID]|termLabel [termID]|termLabel [termID]. Example: Annotating a fish swimming in the upper 100 m of the Atlantic Ocean, consider: ocean water [ENVO:00002151]. Example: Annotating a duck on a pond consider: pond water [ENVO:00002228]|air ENVO_00002005. If needed, request new terms on the ENVO tracker, identified here: http://www.obofoundry.org/ontology/envo.html

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000020
fields.title: subspecf_gen_lin
fields.description: This should provide further information about the genetic distinctness of the sequenced organism by recording additional information e.g. serovar, serotype, biotype, ecotype, or any relevant genetic typing schemes like Group I plasmid. It can also contain alternative taxonomic information. It should contain both the lineage name, and the lineage rank, i.e. biovar:abc123

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000021
fields.title: ploidy
fields.description: The ploidy level of the genome (e.g. allopolyploid, haploid, diploid, triploid, tetraploid). It has implications for the downstream study of duplicated gene and regions of the genomes (and perhaps for difficulties in assembly). For terms, please select terms listed under class ploidy (PATO:001374) of Phenotypic Quality Ontology (PATO), and for a browser of PATO (v 2018-03-27) please refer to http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/PATO

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000022
fields.title: num_replicons
fields.description: Reports the number of replicons in a nuclear genome of eukaryotes, in the genome of a bacterium or archaea or the number of segments in a segmented virus. Always applied to the haploid chromosome count of a eukaryote

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000023
fields.title: extrachrom_elements
fields.description: Do plasmids exist of significant phenotypic consequence (e.g. ones that determine virulence or antibiotic resistance). Megaplasmids? Other plasmids (borrelia has 15+ plasmids)

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000024
fields.title: estimated_size
fields.description: The estimated size of the genome prior to sequencing. Of particular importance in the sequencing of (eukaryotic) genome which could remain in draft form for a long or unspecified period.

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000025
fields.title: ref_biomaterial
fields.description: Primary publication if isolated before genome publication; otherwise, primary genome report

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000026
fields.title: source_mat_id
fields.description: A unique identifier assigned to a material sample (as defined by http://rs.tdwg.org/dwc/terms/materialSampleID, and as opposed to a particular digital record of a material sample) used for extracting nucleic acids, and subsequent sequencing. The identifier can refer either to the original material collected or to any derived sub-samples. The INSDC qualifiers /specimen_voucher, /bio_material, or /culture_collection may or may not share the same value as the source_mat_id field. For instance, the /specimen_voucher qualifier and source_mat_id may both contain ´UAM:Herps:14´ , referring to both the specimen voucher and sampled tissue with the same identifier. However, the /culture_collection qualifier may refer to a value from an initial culture (e.g. ATCC:11775) while source_mat_id would refer to an identifier from some derived culture from which the nucleic acids were extracted (e.g. xatc123 or ark:/2154/R2).

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000027
fields.title: pathogenicity
fields.description: To what is the entity pathogenic

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000028
fields.title: biotic_relationship
fields.description: Description of relationship(s) between the subject organism and other organism(s) it is associated with. E.g., parasite on species X; mutualist with species Y. The target organism is the subject of the relationship, and the other organism(s) is the object

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000029
fields.title: specific_host
fields.description: If there is a host involved, please provide its taxid (or environmental if not actually isolated from the dead or alive host - i.e. a pathogen could be isolated from a swipe of a bench etc) and report whether it is a laboratory or natural host)

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000030
fields.title: host_spec_range
fields.description: The NCBI taxonomy identifier of the specific host if it is known

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000031
fields.title: host_disease_stat
fields.description: List of diseases with which the host has been diagnosed; can include multiple diagnoses. The value of the field depends on host; for humans the terms should be chosen from the DO (Human Disease Ontology) at https://www.disease-ontology.org, non-human host diseases are free text

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000032
fields.title: trophic_level
fields.description: Trophic levels are the feeding position in a food chain. Microbes can be a range of producers (e.g. chemolithotroph)

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000033
fields.title: propagation
fields.description: This field is specific to different taxa. For phages: lytic/lysogenic, for plasmids: incompatibility group, for eukaryotes: sexual/asexual (Note: there is the strong opinion to name phage propagation obligately lytic or temperate, therefore we also give this choice

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000034
fields.title: encoded_traits
fields.description: Should include key traits like antibiotic resistance or xenobiotic degradation phenotypes for plasmids, converting genes for phage

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000015
fields.title: rel_to_oxygen
fields.description: Is this organism an aerobe, anaerobe? Please note that aerobic and anaerobic are valid descriptors for microbial environments

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000003
fields.title: isol_growth_condt
fields.description: Publication reference in the form of pubmed ID (pmid), digital object identifier (doi) or url for isolation and growth condition specifications of the organism/material

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000002
fields.title: samp_collec_device
fields.description: The device used to collect an environmental sample. This field accepts terms listed under environmental sampling device (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/ENVO). This field also accepts terms listed under specimen collection device (http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/GENEPIO_0002094).

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0001225
fields.title: samp_collec_method
fields.description: The method employed for collecting the sample

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000016
fields.title: samp_mat_process
fields.description: Any processing applied to the sample during or after retrieving the sample from environment. This field accepts OBI, for a browser of OBI (v 2018-02-12) terms please see http://purl.bioontology.org/ontology/OBI

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000017
fields.title: size_frac
fields.description: Filtering pore size used in sample preparation

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000001
fields.title: samp_size
fields.description: Amount or size of sample (volume, mass or area) that was collected

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000111
fields.title: samp_vol_we_dna_ext
fields.description: Volume (ml) or mass (g) of total collected sample processed for DNA extraction. Note: total sample collected should be entered under the term Sample Size (MIXS:0000001).

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000035
fields.title: source_uvig
fields.description: Type of dataset from which the UViG was obtained

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000036
fields.title: virus_enrich_appr
fields.description: List of approaches used to enrich the sample for viruses, if any

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000037
fields.title: nucl_acid_ext
fields.description: A link to a literature reference, electronic resource or a standard operating procedure (SOP), that describes the material separation to recover the nucleic acid fraction from a sample

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000038
fields.title: nucl_acid_amp
fields.description: A link to a literature reference, electronic resource or a standard operating procedure (SOP), that describes the enzymatic amplification (PCR, TMA, NASBA) of specific nucleic acids

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000039
fields.title: lib_size
fields.description: Total number of clones in the library prepared for the project

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000040
fields.title: lib_reads_seqd
fields.description: Total number of clones sequenced from the library

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000041
fields.title: lib_layout
fields.description: Specify whether to expect single, paired, or other configuration of reads

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000042
fields.title: lib_vector
fields.description: Cloning vector type(s) used in construction of libraries

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000043
fields.title: lib_screen
fields.description: Specific enrichment or screening methods applied before and/or after creating libraries

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000044
fields.title: target_gene
fields.description: Targeted gene or locus name for marker gene studies

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000045
fields.title: target_subfragment
fields.description: Name of subfragment of a gene or locus. Important to e.g. identify special regions on marker genes like V6 on 16S rRNA

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000046
fields.title: pcr_primers
fields.description: PCR primers that were used to amplify the sequence of the targeted gene, locus or subfragment. This field should contain all the primers used for a single PCR reaction if multiple forward or reverse primers are present in a single PCR reaction. The primer sequence should be reported in uppercase letters

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000047
fields.title: mid
fields.description: Molecular barcodes, called Multiplex Identifiers (MIDs), that are used to specifically tag unique samples in a sequencing run. Sequence should be reported in uppercase letters

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000048
fields.title: adapters
fields.description: Adapters provide priming sequences for both amplification and sequencing of the sample-library fragments. Both adapters should be reported; in uppercase letters

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000049
fields.title: pcr_cond
fields.description: Description of reaction conditions and components of PCR in the form of ´initial denaturation:94degC_1.5min; annealing=...´

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000050
fields.title: seq_meth
fields.description: Sequencing method used; e.g. Sanger, ABI-solid

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000051
fields.title: seq_quality_check
fields.description: Indicate if the sequence has been called by automatic systems (none) or undergone a manual editing procedure (e.g. by inspecting the raw data or chromatograms). Applied only for sequences that are not submitted to SRA,ENA or DRA

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000052
fields.title: chimera_check
fields.description: A chimeric sequence, or chimera for short, is a sequence comprised of two or more phylogenetically distinct parent sequences. Chimeras are usually PCR artifacts thought to occur when a prematurely terminated amplicon reanneals to a foreign DNA strand and is copied to completion in the following PCR cycles. The point at which the chimeric sequence changes from one parent to the next is called the breakpoint or conversion point

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000053
fields.title: tax_ident
fields.description: The phylogenetic marker(s) used to assign an organism name to the SAG or MAG

fields.name: https://w3id.org/mixs/0000056
fields.title: assembly_qual
fields.description: The assembly quality category is based on sets of criteria outlined for each assembly quality category. For MISAG/MIMAG; Finished: Single, validated, contiguous sequence per replicon without gaps or ambiguities with a consensus error rate equivalent to Q50 or better. High Quality Draft:Multiple fragments where gaps span repetitive regions. Presence of the 23S, 16S and 5S rRNA genes and at least 18 tRNAs. Medium Quality Draft:Many fragments with little to no review of assembly other than reporting of standard assembly statistics. Low Quality Draft:Many fragments with little to no review of assembly other than reporting of standard assembly statistics. Assembly statistics include, but are not limited to total assembly size, number of contigs, contig N50/L50, and maximum contig length. For MIUVIG; Finished: Single, validated, contiguous sequence per replicon without gaps or ambiguities, with extensive manual review and editing to annotate putative gene functions and transcriptional units. High-quality draft genome: One or multiple fragments, totaling ≥ 90% of the expected genome or replicon sequence or predicted complete. Genome fragment(s): One or multiple fragments, totalling < 90% of the expected genome or replicon sequence, or for which no genome size could be estimated
